MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Task ratings completed after the session, on 1-10 sliders.

session_id.Description: Session in which the questionnaire was completed.

gong_reliability.Description: Whether the gong provided a reliable nudge into deeper meditative states (1 = did not help at all or hurt, 10 = helped immensely). The column name is historical: the item asks whether the gong helped, not whether it was heard.

tones_distracting.Description: How distracting the auditory cues were (1 = not distracting at all, 10 = completely distracting or disruptive).
